title: Survival
one_line: Mongoose vs viper in the jungle: leap and bite the snakes crawling out of their holes, or play the viper and strike with your head.
how_to_play: Tap once to start. Phone: drag left side to move, hold BITE, tap FURY. Computer: WASD + mouse/Space to bite, E for Fury, T to change mode.
description: Five modes: Mongoose vs AI, two mongooses vs AI, Mongoose vs Viper (player vs player), Viper vs AI mongoose, and two vipers vs AI mongooses. The whole pack waits in holes in the ground and one viper at a time comes out to fight each mongoose, while other mongooses roam the jungle. Vipers spit venom from far away, and up close they stand up and strike with their head. Every level brings a bigger viper pack and the mongoose's power grows to match, so both sides always have the same total strength; against the AI, human players get a 10% edge. Levels 1 to 100 with one-tap level jump, touch controls, keyboard, mouse and game controller support.
